Document Section: COMPANY SNAPSHOT
Content:
Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 1938 by Danish engineers Henning Holck-Larsen and Søren Kristian Toubro and incorporated in 1946. Today the group operates in more than 50 countries and is listed on the NSE and BSE (ticker: LT), with no single majority shareholder.
